description.value: Douce Diner is a celebrated North Vancouver breakfast-and-lunch spot helmed by chef/owner Dawn Doucette, a Top Chef Canada competitor whose globally-inspired diner menu has earned praise from the Vancouver Sun, Globe and Mail, and Georgia Straight. The restaurant occupies a stylishly renovated diner space with patio seating and a take-out window, making it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists riding the North Shore. Chef Doucette sources organic and local BC ingredients, with standout dishes including panko fried chicken, shakshuka, and a strong selection of vegetarian and vegan options.
